next.reason: 1985: "Data-name-1 has the format 'YYMMDD' ... the date on which the MCS recognizes that the message is complete."; 2023: "No communication description entry in 2023; no candidate defines a CD message-date field.". The 2023 standard has no communication description entry. Its RECEIVE rule and the date candidates (ACCEPT, functions) do not state the CD message-date field that the MCS updates.
